text: To the 'Systems Reply' (the person does not understand Chinese, but the whole system does), Searle's own rejoinder is that...
choices: a robot body with sensorimotor links would supply the missing understanding
simulating every neuron of a Chinese speaker's brain would produce understanding
the person could internalize the entire system -- memorizing all the rules and symbols -- and still not understand Chinese
the system has high integrated information and is therefore conscious
explanation: Searle answers the Systems Reply by internalizing the system: the person memorizes the rulebook and symbols and works outdoors, thereby BECOMING the whole system, yet still understands no Chinese. The other options are the Robot Reply, the Brain-Simulator Reply, and an IIT consideration, none of which is his response to the Systems Reply.
